limitations: Complete same-talk transcript is generous semantic preparation; references authored by implementation operator, not independent.
References exclude six seconds on both sides of each section boundary; chapter percentages can conceal transition delay and intra-idea view switching.
No underlying datasets or original visual assets were provided to either preparation/follower package. Source frames were inspected only as evaluation references.
No controller, recognition or alias tuning after the new follower results; preparation clarifications precede each first replay.
Two new talks do not complete the independent multi-talk editorial corpus or establish audience comprehension.

Comparison HTML players are generated from actual renderer and saved traces; browser automation was declined, so browser layout/synchronization and physical microphone/projector timing remain unverified.

long_quote_repair.qualification: Operator supplied an overlong request; the app stored only its first 5000 characters.

preparation_audit.source_review_correction: Mystery dataset and Facebook reveal are the same example; corrected summary and comparison labels before any follower output.

paced_sivers.asr: openai-whisper tiny.en, CPU, 4 threads, 48 tokens, 2 s subprocess deadline
paced_sivers.timing_model: Measured wall time, one-second PCM arrivals over authenticated loopback HTTP.
limitations: WAV excerpt feeds the actual local audio API at wall-clock pace; no simulated decoder costs.
No browser capture/permission/paint or physical microphone/projector measurement.
Same-talk transcript supplied as advance preparation; no independent editorial accuracy assessment.
Shared machine; excludes up to one second of audio collection and time needed to hear a distinctive cue.
paced_sivers.execution_note: Probe emitted final metrics after cleanup and persisted the complete 172-update artifact; outer command reported exit 143. No remaining probe process. Measurement completeness is verified from the saved worker counts and stage observations; do not interpret the wrapper exit as a clean process status.

observed_stage_topic_alignment.basis: Actual read-only stage observation times, same previously fixed reference and exclusions; no simulated decisions.

shutdown_diagnostic.qualification: Separate one-second shutdown check completed cleanly; not included as a talk-quality or full-run timing result.

findings: Sivers first-pass local trace briefly selects the momentum idea at 22.87 s and returns to the first-follower idea at 26.04 s. Its high aggregate chapter alignment conceals that wrong switch.
McCandless initial valid five-idea draft omits three substantial topics. All five prepared ideas appear, but coverage of the full talk remains poor.
Operator-assisted ten-idea preparation greatly improves coarse topic following without runtime changes, but not source-graphic fidelity.

Expanded McCandless local trace has ten within-idea view changes, including six alternations between explanatory and evidence cards during supplement curation. Such changes need editorial evaluation despite correct topic labels.
At the volcano comparison the expanded local trace retains a generic information-design definition, so the right chapter label does not imply the most useful specific scene is displayed.
Original crowd footage, financial areas, temporal peaks, relative scales, evidence map and worldview diagram carry visual evidence absent from these transcript-only packages.
